visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three women in traditional-style qipao dresses stand together in a professional photography studio. The woman on the right wears black, the center wears red, and the left wears pink. They wave cheerfully at the camera. The background features light stands and a studio umbrella, with bright, flat lighting. (2) The woman in the black qipao stands alone in a modern living room. She crosses her arms tightly and maintains a stern, tough facial expression with a slight pout. She leans her face closer to the lens with a defiant look. Behind her are minimalist white shelves and a designer lamp. (3) The woman in the pink qipao is seated on a soft beige couch in a warm, domestic setting. She smiles broadly while performing a sequence of hand gestures: one finger up, two fingers, three fingers, and then a finger-heart near her chest. The lighting is soft and golden, creating a friendly atmosphere. (4) The woman in the red qipao stands between red studio curtains and black equipment poles. She acts in a playful, childish manner, grabbing a pole and shaking her head while making cute crying-style gestures with her fists to her cheeks. The scene is brightly lit, emphasizing the vivid red color of her dress and the backdrop.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice provides a spoken introduction with moderate pitch and clear articulation. This is immediately followed by a cheerful, mid-tempo pop BGM featuring a light female vocal. The acoustic floor is studio-clean, with no ambient noise or interference, and a high signal-to-noise ratio. (2) The audio track shifts abruptly to a high-arousal hip-hop/trap beat with a prominent, heavy bass kick and sharp snare hits. An authoritative female vocal sings aggressively over the beat. The transition is a hard cut, and the music exhibits significant dynamic compression and a bright spectral centroid. (3) The music changes to a friendly, upbeat acoustic-pop style with a prominent piano or guitar texture and a moderate BPM. A male vocal with a warm, positive tone sings "one, two, three" in sync with the rhythm. The mix is balanced and clear, with no technical artifacts. (4) A final hard cut introduces a fast-tempo pop-rock track with distorted electric guitar textures and a high-pitched, energetic male vocal. The spectral density is high, creating a sense of excitement and chaos. There is no incidental or ambient noise, indicating a fully post-produced master track.
